scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@shadowing-recorder/web && npm run build --workspace=@shadowing-recorder/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@shadowing-recorder/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@shadowing-recorder/web"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
